property_summary: For every filled short order (isLong == false), the contract must record the position expiration under the LONG position id (hashOppositeOrder), i.e. positionExpirations[uint256(hashOppositeOrder(order))] == block.timestamp + duration; the mutant instead writes it under the short orderHash, leaving the long position's expiration zero.
change_summary: Always write the expiration under uint256(orderHash) instead of branching on order.isLong, so short fills record the expiration at the wrong key.
